title: Example structural direction
thesis: One sentence naming the physical visual thesis.

visual_target.final_image_thesis: One sentence describing the image, material world, and dominant read—not only the mechanism.
visual_target.material_intent: Named surface, volume, or emissive response with editable MaterialX controls.
visual_target.framing_intent: Neutral coverage plus a direction-specific hero composition.
visual_target.lighting_intent: Locked neutral baseline plus an authored hero treatment.
visual_target.temporal_signature: What remains visibly legible across early, middle, late, and continuous motion.

state_to_form_mappings.houdini_mechanism: Exact SOP, VEX, USD, or MaterialX mechanism.
state_to_form_mappings.acceptance_observable: A visible or measured result that proves the mapping landed.

representation_system: Curves, instances, surfaces, volumes, or another named Houdini system.
lighting_assumptions: A fixed neutral comparison rig plus an authored hero lighting treatment.
motion_proposition: What persists, relaxes, accumulates, moves, or disappears.
risks: The primary way this direction could become generic, decorative, or unreadable.
cheapest_decisive_probe: The smallest live-Houdini artifact that can disprove the thesis.
stop_conditions: Stop when a named source attribute is absent or a required mapping cannot be demonstrated.

implementation_stages.title: Inspect the authoritative caches
implementation_stages.intent: Measure real attribute ranges and temporal behavior before designing controls.
implementation_stages.houdini_strategy: Load frozen caches into a labelled SOURCE branch and record ranges without changing Behavior.
implementation_stages.acceptance_observable: The implementation plan records measured source ranges and representative frames.

implementation_stages.title: Build the primary state-to-form system
implementation_stages.intent: Establish the direction's dominant physical metaphor.
implementation_stages.houdini_strategy: Build a dedicated LOOK_PRIMARY branch with exposed remap and scale controls.
implementation_stages.output: Cooked primary geometry driven by the source data.
implementation_stages.acceptance_observable: Low and high source values create measurably different primary form.

implementation_stages.title: Build supporting layers and hierarchy
implementation_stages.intent: Connect secondary simulation data to distinct, subordinate visual systems.
implementation_stages.houdini_strategy: Create adjacent, independently switchable SOP branches and merge them explicitly after validation.
implementation_stages.output: A readable multi-layer assembly rather than one monolithic network.
implementation_stages.acceptance_observable: Primary and supporting layers remain independently legible in a neutral probe.

implementation_stages.title: Prove the temporal read and package the graph
implementation_stages.intent: Validate the full direction in motion and leave a clean artist-facing scene.
implementation_stages.houdini_strategy: Cook early, middle, and late probes, organize connected networks top-to-bottom, save, reopen, and recook the canonical HIP.
implementation_stages.output: Canonical HIP, probe media, implementation plan, and graph audit.
implementation_stages.acceptance_observable: The reopened HIP cooks without node errors and temporal probes demonstrate the intended evolution.
